decision: verify:ac binds a clause artifact only from the declared plan.metadata.swarm.file_scope surface, and closes the read at walkOne

governingRule.description: A gate must not let untrusted input choose what it reads or reports

alternativesConsidered.option: Filter the shape of prose-extracted paths (deny dotfiles, VCS metadata, placeholders)
Resolve artifact_path against plan.items instead of the raw statement
Reject the binding entirely and let countAdjudicableClauses === 0 excuse the walk

whyWinner: Shape filtering was measured to narrow the attack by zero: the working attack was built with every proposed shape rule already applied. plan.items is extractPlanItems(bodyStr), the same untrusted prose one hop later. Emptying the adjudicable set makes ok true with zero positive evidence, so the walk must lose its excusal instead. file_scope is inside the brief, already carries the #3145 digest and humanApproval gate, and a GitHub commenter cannot write it.
revisitTrigger: If briefs start declaring file_scope widely and clause walking regains real capability, re-measure whether the per-clause verified requirement is too strict
